config.purpose: DECISIVE TEST: does the suffix suppress the shadow digit specifically, or is it hardcoded to digit 9? Change inner bindings from 9-prefixed to {2,5}-prefixed and check whether suppression follows the shadow digit.

predictions.H_shadow_tracking: Suppression follows the shadow digit: shadow2 suppresses P(2), shadow5 suppresses P(5), shadow9 suppresses P(9). The gain(correct) â‰ˆ -drop(shadow) correlation holds for each condition. This confirms boundary-conditioned shadow attenuation.
predictions.H_token_prior: Suppression is always on P(9) regardless of shadow digit. The mechanism is a token-specific prior, not shadow-tracking.
predictions.H_generic_sharpening: y=z controls (target matches shadow) retain the gain. The mechanism is generic sharpening, not competitor suppression.
predictions.decisive_test: At d4, shadow2 condition with target=7: does drop in P(2) match gain in P(7)? If yes, shadow tracking confirmed.

design_notes.outer_values_chosen: 1,3,7,9 covers: two values that never collide with any shadow (1,3,7 for shadow2/5; 1,3 for shadow9), and two y=z controls (9 for shadow9, 2 for shadow2 implicit).
